objectClass.notes: A soft-vinyl toy of a low-poly game character, not a character render. Hard flat facets, visible edge creases, matte vinyl and zero smoothing groups are the identity. Ten separable parts with clean cylindrical/socketed joints.

reasoning: Deep hierarchy and a strict socket contract drive the tier, not surface detail.
Surface detail is deliberately low: the real object has no wear, dirt, scratches or relief.
The asymmetric arms mean the left and right chains cannot be mirrored, doubling the arm component count.

specDepthDecision.rationale: Four orthographic reference views and a ten-part delivery contract require a socketed hierarchy three to six levels deep. Material depth is intentionally shallow because the subject genuinely has one flat albedo per zone.

detailInventory.note: Zones were scanned with forge/stage1_intake/build_detail_inventory.py over front, back, left and right (spec/detail-inventory/<view>/). Every detail below maps to a real component.localFeatures or material.localOverrides id.

details.description: 9-11 flat-sided wedge spikes welded into the cap in an asymmetric fan; one dominant forward spike sets Y=1.000
shallow V crease down the centre-back of the cap where the radial facet fan converges
single thin fringe wedge hanging past the brow to Y=0.740, separate from the cap
eyes, lash line, brows and mouth are printed flat on one unbroken facet; no eye geometry
thin brown band around the neck base, proud of the skin
two brown shoulder straps stand proud of the shirt with a hard step on both long edges
the straps cross the shoulder blades as dark triangular panels
belt band stands proud of both the shirt above and the yoke below
hip yoke panel ends in a downward V whose tip is at Y=0.435, stepped proud of the pant body
the same chevron repeats on the back at the same height
continuous gap line along the whole deltoid/pauldron boundary - the cap is a separate shell
grey bracer is wider than the forearm and overhangs the fist on the outer face
flat horizontal cut where skin meets the black fist, no taper
sole slab top face steps out from under the cuff at Y=0.085 as a clean ledge
vertical crease down the centre of each thigh, present under two different lightings
inverted-V notch cut between the legs, apex Y=0.269 - a real silhouette opening
every vertical edge on the boxy parts carries a small hard chamfer that catches a bright rim line

anatomy.proportionNote: Figurine proportions, deliberately NOT human. The head box is the hair-inclusive silhouette from chin Y=0.69 to cap crown Y=0.905. Shoulder width is only 0.93 HU where a realistic adult is 1.5-2 HU, and the hip is wider than the shoulders - both are correct for this super-deformed toy and must not be 'fixed' toward human anatomy. If the spike tips are counted as head height instead of the cap crown, the figure reads as 3.2 HU.

pose.type: symmetric standing, weight even, arms held out and broken forward at the elbow
pose.note: Angles are derived from the measured socket endpoints in componentTree attachments; the endpoints are the authority, the angles are the readable summary.

faceLandmarks.boxDefinition: head bounding box = chin Y=0.69 to hair cap crown Y=0.905, hair included
faceLandmarks.note: eyeLine measured: the dark lash band occupies front.webp y=192-215, centre y=203 (absolute Y=0.755), which is 0.773 down the hair-inclusive head box. That sits far below the 0.45-0.55 realistic band because the bulky hair cap owns the top half of the box. eyeSpacing is the 28 px inner-corner gap over the 180 px cap width. noseBase and mouthLine are low-confidence: nothing below y=215 clears the dark-pixel threshold, so both features are very faint print.

features: spiked gold hair in an asymmetric fan
printed angular blue eyes with a hard lash line
black pauldron on the figure's left shoulder only
grey bracer on the figure's left forearm only
black cuboid fists with no fingers
rhombic pant mass wider and deeper than the shoulders
olive boots: cuff block over a forward sole wedge
anatomy.note: Overlay generated by forge/stage1_intake/extract_landmarks.py; its drawn guides are generic starting positions and were replaced by the measured values above.

resolvedReadingLedger.question: Are the straps warm brown or cool olive?
resolvedReadingLedger.evidence: more-angle.webp separates strap from belt; the product shots collapse both

resolvedReadingLedger.readingA: noseBase 0.78 / mouthLine 0.88 of the head box
resolvedReadingLedger.readingB: no printed nose or mouth at all below the eye band

resolvedReadingLedger.evidence: the side view overlaps both staggered feet, so 0.182 spans two soles, not one

definitionOfDone: The rendered figure matches references/front.webp, back.webp, left.webp and right.webp in silhouette, the landmark heights in silhouette.landmarks, component hierarchy, flat-faceted shading and the nine-colour palette.
All three hard silhouette gates hold: hip wider than the shoulders, kite hip profile in side view, torso width:depth 2.0-2.4:1.
The handedness asymmetry is correct on all four orthographic views.
Every one of the ten Stage 1 parts explodes and is individually clickable.

featureGroups.name: The three hard silhouette gates
qualityCriteria: Max hip width 0.267 exceeds torso shoulder width 0.2; measured on the front render, not asserted.
Left-view hip profile is a kite with a sharp front and back point, max depth 0.142 at Y=0.335.
failureModes: hip built narrower than the shoulders
hip built as a cylinder, a skirt or a box
torso built with a square cross-section

featureGroups.name: Asymmetric armour
qualityCriteria: Figure's left (+X) carries the black pauldron and the grey bracer.
Figure's right (-X) carries a bare deltoid and no bracer.
Both fists are black with no finger geometry.

featureGroups.name: Flat-faceted vinyl shading
qualityCriteria: flatShading is true on every mesh; no smoothed vertex normals anywhere.
metalness 0 and roughness 0.80-0.90 on every visible material; no clearcoat, sheen or transmission.
Value variation comes only from facet orientation, not from a normal or bump map.
failureModes: subdivision or smoothing erases the facets
a specular hotspot appears on the vinyl
normal maps are introduced where the reference shows no relief

featureGroups.name: Nine-colour palette with strap and belt distinct
qualityCriteria: Strap brown and belt brown render as two distinguishable colours.
Shirt purple and pant purple render as two distinguishable values.
The printed face is the only textured surface in the model.
failureModes: strap and belt collapse into one olive
one purple used for both shirt and pants
face modelled as geometry instead of print

featureGroups.name: Ten parts on sockets, explodable and clickable
qualityCriteria: Every child component attaches at its parent socket with the recorded overlap and gap tolerance.
No child geometry is centred in space instead of pivoting from its socket.
All ten Stage 1 parts explode along their socket axes and re-seat.
failureModes: a child root floats away from its parent
parent-child transforms mix world and local coordinates

visualDeltaChecks: front/back/left/right silhouette IoU against the four orthographic references
handedness check: pauldron and bracer on +X only
facet-count and flat-shading delta (no smoothing introduced)
palette delta per material against the recorded warm/cool pair
antiShallowSpecRules: Do not proceed to code if qualityContract.qualityBar is unassessed.
Do not proceed to code if the spec only contains a root component for a moderate or complex object.
Do not proceed to code if required featureGroups are not represented by componentTree, materials, or repetitionSystems.
Do not proceed to code if visible local features are described only in prose and not attached to components/materials/evidenceRefs.
Do not proceed past structural-pass if attached child parts lack attachment.parentSocket, localStart, localEnd, embedDepth/overlap, and gapTolerance.
Do not pass material look-dev when albedo is reused as roughness, height, normal, or AO.
Do not pass material look-dev without macro, meso, and micro surface frequency bands for close-up materials.
Do not pass reference-fidelity material look-dev from a source image without usable referencePbr maps or an explicit documented limitation.
Do not patch a spec with extracted PBR maps when extraction confidence is below the target threshold unless the user explicitly accepts lower fidelity.
Do not place adjacent separate-geometry parts below 0.02 world-unit seam overlap (source: grimoire/build/geometry_patterns.md).
Do not satisfy raised or recessed relief, fasteners, or grip structure with a map alone when the feature affects form; use geometry or displacement (source: grimoire/build/geometry_patterns.md).
Adjacent components must overlap by at least 0.02 world units at shared seams (source: grimoire/build/geometry_patterns.md).
Raised or recessed relief and fasteners must be geometry, instanced micro-parts, or displacement; a map alone is an approximation (source: grimoire/build/geometry_patterns.md).
Do not smooth vertex normals on any component; flatShading is an identity feature, not a finish.
Do not mirror the shoulder or forearm chains; the armour is asymmetric.
Do not build the hip mass as a cylinder, capsule or skirt.
Do not model eye geometry; the face is printed art.
Do not add wear, dirt, scratches or chips; the reference is factory-fresh vinyl.
Do not raise texture resolution above the source crop size; upsampling is invented detail.
